title: Modular wall signs
central_assumption: Visitors can read the signs from the entrance.
proposal: Place a compact directory near the entrance and consistent floor markers at decision points.
dependencies: Confirm viewing distance and permitted mounting locations.
risks: A narrow wall may limit readable type size.
rough_effort: One layout study and one visitor trial.
falsifying_test: Reject this layout if a visitor trial shows that the required text cannot be read at the intended distance.
